row.title: Give data subjects the full text of the transfer clauses within 15 days of a request
row.statement: The controller shall make available to the data subject, on request, the full text of the clauses used for the international data transfer, subject to commercial and industrial secrets, within 15 days of the request unless specific ANPD regulation sets a different period.
row.deadline: Within 15 days of the data subject's request (unless ANPD regulation sets a different period)

deadline_rule.applies_to: data subject requests for the full text of the international transfer clauses

row.quote:
Art. 17. O controlador deverá disponibilizar ao titular, em caso de solicitação, a íntegra das cláusulas utilizadas para a realização da transferência internacional de dados, observados os segredos comercial e industrial.
 § 1º O prazo para atendimento da solicitação é de 15 (quinze) dias, ressalvada a hipótese de prazo distinto estabelecido em regulamentação específica da ANPD.
row.quote_en: Art. 17. The controller shall make available to the data subject, upon request, the full text of the clauses used to carry out the international data transfer, subject to commercial and industrial secrets. § 1. The period for responding to the request is 15 (fifteen) days, save where a different period is established in specific ANPD regulation.

row.title: Treat any noxious, unintended response to any dose of a trial drug as an adverse drug reaction (Division 5 scope)
row.statement: For Division 5 clinical trial safety reporting and records, the sponsor must treat as an adverse drug reaction any noxious and unintended response to a drug that is caused by the administration of any dose of the drug.

row.title: Record as adverse events all adverse health occurrences in trial subjects, related or not (Division 5 scope)
row.statement: For the Division 5 adverse event records, the sponsor must treat as an adverse event any adverse occurrence in the health of a clinical trial subject who is administered a drug, whether or not caused by the drug, including adverse drug reactions.

row.title: Classify a clinical trial ADR as serious using the Division 5 criteria
row.statement: For Division 5 reporting, the sponsor must classify an adverse drug reaction as serious if it requires in-patient hospitalization or prolongs existing hospitalization, causes congenital malformation, results in persistent or significant disability or incapacity, is life threatening or results in death.

row.title: Assess expectedness against the investigator's brochure or drug label to identify reportable SUSARs
row.statement: For SUSAR reporting under C.05.014, the sponsor must treat a serious ADR as unexpected when it is not identified in nature, severity or frequency in the risk information in the investigator's brochure or on the label of the drug.
